The '''Quiberon Line''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that ran from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]  [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to the extragalactic [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] received billions of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to produce [[Starship/Legends|starships]], vehicles and equipment for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] on [[Rothana/Legends|Rothana]]. To preserve secrecy, KDY charted the line to connect Rothana and Kamino. In the years leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], starships and vehicles traveled back and forth along the hyperlane for testing this new army.<ref name="TEGtW" />
